Raven Industries (RAVN) Shareholder Tygh Capital Management Has Cut Position by $2.16 Million; As Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) Stock Value Declined, Adelphi Capital Llp Increased Its Holding
May 16, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Tygh Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Raven Industries Inc (RAVN) by 63.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tygh Capital Management Inc sold 63,441 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.57% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 36,950 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.27M, down from 100,391 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tygh Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Raven Industries Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.47B market cap company. The stock increased 1.37% or $0.55 during the last trading session, reaching $40.8. About 7,247 shares traded. Raven Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ:RAVN) has risen 18.49% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.94% the S&P500.
Adelphi Capital Llp increased its stake in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) by 2.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Adelphi Capital Llp bought 73,703 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.44% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.46M shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $117.15M, up from 3.39 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Adelphi Capital Llp who had been investing in Liberty Global Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $23.26 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $28.93. About 261,635 shares traded. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYK) has declined 10.09% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.64% the S&P500.
